limitations: Embedded srcdoc modules counted through visible parent pages
Professional development progress is optional self-report, not verified completion or impact
PDF guide clicks do not establish download completion or reading
Shared public summaries remain grouped by section/event; role and resource detail is local only
Workbench and pathway interactions do not establish completed training; personal plan text is never collected
Development need selections are optional fixed-ID choices, not a staff survey or performance evaluation
Annual work companion interactions measure use only; personal task statuses and search text are never collected
Advanced simulation completion means the selected learning attempt reached its generated debrief; focused drills and appropriate safety stops are not full procedures or competency passes
Seven older simulation completion hooks measure knowledge-review result panels only; procedural-training completion remains partial
Legacy activity completions require a start accepted after opt-in; earlier unconsented attempts are not backfilled
Demonstrations, menus, camera actions and source panels are not counted as practice starts
Assembled handwashing and decoded gloving and wound-dressing lessons receive the tracker after document replacement; loading shells are not counted as extra page views
